LLCs have to pay this fee because they are considered to be pass-through entities, which means that the profits and losses of the LLC are passed through to the owners. The annual fee is used to help offset the cost of running the states business entity program.

  This includes maintaining records, processing filings, and providing customer service. While it may seem like an unnecessary expense, paying the annual fee is essential for keeping your LLC in good standing. Additionally, failing to pay the annual fee can result in late fees, penalties, and even the loss of your LLCs good standing status .

   What is included in the annual fee payment for LLCs in Kentucky  While the fees for operating an LLC in Kentucky are relatively low, there are still a few items that need to be paid on an annual basis.

  The first is the filing fee for the Articles of Organization, which is $40.  Next is the annual report fee , which is $15.  Lastly, there is the optional Registered Agent service fee, which is $60 per year.

parallel-fast.title: copyright registration | Wex | US Law | LII / Legal Information Institute
parallel-fast.snippet:
copyright registration

Copyright registration is the process for filing a copyright with the U.S. Copyright Office created by § 408 of the Copyright Act of 1976 . Registration consists of sending to the Copyright Office a copyright application, fee, and deposit of the work, which is separate from the deposit requirement in § 407 for the Library of Congress.
A person gains copyright protection over a work at its formulation under § 102 , but a person must register with the Copyright Office before bringing a civil action for copyright infringement under § 411 . In the 2019 case of Fourth Estate Public Benefit Corporation v. Wall-Street.com, LLC , the Supreme Court held that registration and the right to bring a civil suit occur when the Register of Copyrights actually registers the work, not when the Copyright Office receives the registration.
[Last reviewed in June of 2021 by the Wex Definitions Team ]
